model.name: R19.77: URL file preview shows two buttons — Open in preview (inline iframe) and Open in new tab.
model.description: When previewing a URL-type file unit (.url/.html.url scenario unit per R19.62), the ContentPreviewer MUST show TWO action buttons: (a) 'Open in preview' — renders the URL inline in the sandboxed preview iframe (R19.64/74 iframe path), and (b) 'Open in new tab' — opens the URL in a new browser tab (window.open with target=_blank). This gives the user the choice between inline preview and full-page navigation.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "that worked well, but add in this case in the preview two buttons to open the url in preview or as a new tab."
model.crossRefNote: R19.62 (URL drop creates url-type unit) provides the file. R19.64 (preview by type) defines the iframe render. R19.65 (ContentPreviewer) is the component. R19.77 adds the two-button choice for URL-type previews.
